jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description:
About Us

Kernel Trading Technologies started as a trading group in a hedge fund and is built on a successful track record of trading systematic strategies powered by scientific and cutting-edge technologies. The team is consisted of successful portfolio managers from top quantitative funds, top-notch machine learning researchers, statistics professors from academia and excellent technologist previously from high-frequency trading space. The team focuses on statistical arbitrage strategies trading global futures and has achieved high return and Sharpe every single year since inception. We are constantly looking for improvements to power and evolve our research and trading platform to expand our success story.
The Role

We are seeking highly qualified and talented Quantitative Researchers to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with our team of portfolio managers, quantitative developers and technologists to develop and improve upon our proprietary trading models and strategies. You will have the opportunity to apply your skills in data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning to real-world financial data, and contribute to the success of our trading operations.
What you’ll do

In this role, you will:

Develop, test, and implement quantitative models for our trading strategies, using advanced statistical techniques and machine learning models
Analyze large datasets to identify trading opportunities and improve model performance
Collaborate with quantitative developers to implement models and strategies in our trading system
Conduct research to stay current on market conditions and industry trends
Communicate complex quantitative concepts and their implications to non-technical team members

What you’ll bring

What you need:

Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Engineering
Strong programming skills, preferably in Python or C++
Solid understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning
Understanding of data structures, algorithmic complexities, and numerical algorithms
Ability to communicate effectively in a collaborative, complex and highly technical team environment
Intellectual curiosity and passion for solving challenging problems using technology

Job Type: Full-Time

Pay: $90,000-$350,000 per year

401(k)

Health insurance
Paid time off

jobs.title: Analytics Engineering - Principal - Chicago
jobs.description:
Description

Company Overview

Teragonia is the AI Operating System for Private Equity, helping sponsors and their portfolio companies turn fragmented operational data into decisions that move EBITDA. We operate in the highest-pressure segment of enterprise performance, where outcomes are time-bound by a 3 to 5 year hold period and execution velocity defines returns. Through Astradis, our AI platform, we unify structured and unstructured data, generate prescriptive insights in near real time, and embed them directly into operating workflows with clear ownership and measurable impact. We partner with PE firms managing more than US$400B in assets and are rapidly expanding globally.

Our work is measured in EBITDA outcomes. Across PE portfolio companies, we drive 3% to 5% EBITDA uplift, accelerate roll-ups through standardized data and KPI frameworks, and maintain continuous exit readiness with high-fidelity performance instrumentation. We are replacing episodic consulting with a compounding AI platform that scales expertise across companies, industries, and ownership cycles. Teragonia is built for high-agency builders who want early responsibility, direct exposure to the world's leading private equity firms and their portfolio CXOs, and the opportunity to help define the operating layer for value creation in the AI era.

Teragonia offers a comprehensive career development platform through cross-learning within our multidisciplinary structure. We nurture a diverse, inclusive, collaborative, respectful, and collegial environment. Our competitive compensation package aligns with the technology industry leaders, encompassing 401k contribution matching, medical insurance, and additional benefits.

Read more about our mission, vision, and values on our website:

About Teragonia: https://teragonia.com/company/
Our Values: https://teragonia.com/careers/
Our Purpose: https://teragonia.com/value-orchestration/

Value Orchestration Engineering (VOE) Department Overview

Teragonia's Value Orchestration Engineering (VOE) division bridges finance, consulting, and technology to support portfolio companies. We combine consulting rigor and AI to address complex challenges and enhance enterprise value through platform solutions and advisory. We prioritize professional growth through mentorship and cross-functional learning.

The Astradis platform provides real-time intelligence through a function-specific command center, combining structured and unstructured data via our Fibron AI layer. Our platform powers diagnostic dashboards, forecasting models, pricing tools, and operations modules, enabling clients to transition from reactive reporting to predictive strategy.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Principal to join our team. As a Principal, you will own client relationships and carry full accountability for engagement success. You will lead delivery teams consisting of a combination of engagement managers, associates, analysts, and AI Operating System (AIOS) engineering team members, serve as the primary point of ownership for getting work done across the firm and with the client, and co-create new opportunities alongside the client executives you serve. Working closely with the Managing Director, who leads the most senior external commercial relationship, you will translate client priorities into outcomes, mobilize the internal team to deliver, and build the trust that expands each account over time.

This is a business leadership role first. We are looking for candidates who think about the health of the overall client business, not only the engagement in front of them: someone who can prioritize across competing demands, communicate a clear point of view to senior clients, develop the people around them, and understand how delivery, client satisfaction, and commercial growth connect. Technical fluency matters, but for this role we weight client leadership, people leadership, and business judgment above hands-on technical execution. We are particularly interested in candidates who operate with integrity, intellectual humility, and a long-term career commitment.

Responsibilities

Client Engagement Leadership

Own client relationships, serving as the trusted point of ownership clients rely on for delivery and outcomes
Partner with the Managing Director on account strategy, taking the lead on execution, internal mobilization, and identifying new growth opportunities within existing accounts, while the MD owns the most senior external commercial relationship.
Co-create new opportunities with clients by understanding their business deeply and connecting their priorities to solutions the firm can deliver
Lead executive-level presentations, read-outs, and strategic conversations with C-suite clients, communicating a clear and credible point of view
Navigate complex client situations with judgment, pushing back constructively when it serves the client and the relationship

Delivery Ownership and Prioritization

Carry full end-to-end accountability for engagement success across 3+ concurrent engagements, from scoping through delivery
Provide the end-to-end thinking required to get work done internally and externally, removing obstacles and making the calls that keep engagements moving
Prioritize effectively across competing demands, allocating your attention and the team's effort to what matters most
Manage engagement economics and profitability across your portfolio, handling scope changes transparently and proactively
Master Service Agreement, Sales Order, and Change Order documentation, with the ability to draft comprehensive scopes of work and management engagement risk

People and Team Leadership

Lead and develop teams of Engagement Managers, Associates, and Analysts, delegating effectively and coaching team members.
Provide consistent direction, timely and actionable feedback, and mentorship that builds independence and leadership in your direct reports
Participate actively in recruiting to attract top talent

Business Leadership and Growth

Think and act like a future business unit leader, understanding how delivery, client outcomes, and commercial growth connect across the business
Work with senior leadership to shape account targets and growth strategies
Build trusted advisor relationships with sponsors, C-suite executives, and operating teams
Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities across the existing client base
Develop case studies with the business development group and represent the firm at relevant networking and industry events
Expand expertise in a chosen industry, functional, or business domain

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Technical Fluency

Guide teams on approach and quality, drawing on enough technical fluency to make sound decisions and ask the right questions, while relying on specialists for hands-on execution
Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and AI engineers to deliver integrated solutions
Stay current with industry trends and apply them to improve client outcomes
Contribute to firm strategy and operational excellence initiatives

Requirements

Necessary Qualifications

Master's degree in Business Analytics, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
8-12 years of relevant experience, including a proven track record of leading client engagements and delivery teams (management consulting, professional services, value creation, or a comparable environment)
Demonstrated ability to own senior client relationships and act as the primary point of delivery ownership for all key stakeholders
Experience in managing multiple complex engagements or workstreams simultaneously, with strong prioritization across competing demands
Proven people leadership, with a track record of developing high-performing team members
Strong business acumen and the ability to understand a client's business end to end and communicate about it credibly
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and executive-presentation skills
Track record of contributing to business development and account growth
Demonstrated ability to manage engagement economics and profitability
Comfort operating in a data- and technology-driven environment, with enough fluency to guide teams and earn client trust (hands-on technical depth is a plus, not the primary requirement)

Preferred Qualifications

Recognized expertise in a specific industry vertical (for example healthcare, industrials, financial services, or business services)
Familiarity with private equity value creation playbooks and operating models
Demonstrated ability to grow green field services revenue other than organic revenue growth through upselling active engagements
Thought leadership presence through publications, speaking engagements, or industry recognition
Working familiarity with data and analytics concepts sufficient to lead technical delivery teams

Benefits

Competitive Total Compensation - We constantly benchmark our pay scales against the market to maintain competitiveness.
Restricted Stock Awards - We offer restricted stock awards to select positions to ensure our teams' long-term commitment and hard work are rewarded by sharing our collective success.
Visa Sponsorship - We offer visa sponsorship for eligible employees.
401k Plan with Employer Contributions - We help secure your future with matching of 401k contributions up to 6%.
Professional Development Opportunities - We will sponsor company-selected training sessions, conferences, and certifications to foster your growth.
Meal Reimbursement - Reimbursement for lunch at the office, and dinner too if you are working past 7 pm, up to a limit.
Gym Membership - Reimbursement for fitness and wellness programs, such as gym memberships, up to a limit.
Commuter Benefits - We offer the opportunity to leverage the available tax concessions for commuting expenses.
Relocation Assistance - Available to those who move to the Chicago, Dallas, New York City, or Houston metropolitan area as required by their job role.
Paid Time Off (PTO) - You will be eligible for 15 to 20 days PTO, depending on level, accrued according to company policies.
Annual Quiet Week - From Dec 24 to Jan 2, we anticipate a quiet week. During this period, all employees may work remotely, and we put in our best effort to keep workload as light as possible in light of balancing business needs.
Firm Holidays - 12 firm-designated holidays annually, in addition to the eligible PTO.
Comprehensive Healthcare, Vision, and Dental Insurance - We prioritize your health and wellness with insurance coverage through leading national providers.
Gynecology, fertility, and family-building benefits through leading providers.
Paid Parental Leave of 12 weeks after 6 months of service with the company.
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) / Health Savings Account (HSA) Plan - We provide the opportunity to manage your healthcare expenses efficiently through FSA/HSA plans.
Mental Health Support - Enroll in our healthcare plan and gain access to mental health support through Talkspace.
HealthAdvocate - Expert assistance to help you navigate the complexities of the healthcare system.
Disability Insurance - We sponsor short term disability insurance through a leading national provider.
Sick Days - We adhere to applicable state regulations, ensuring you have time to recover when you are not feeling well.

Flexible Work Policy

We expect 80% office attendance and do not impose specific days to be at the office. Additional flexibility will be granted upon ad hoc request, balancing organizational needs. We believe brainstorming, planning, training and team building events are most productive in person and expect office presence for such events, including corporate gatherings.

Recruiting Process

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Applied AI Solutions
jobs.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Data Scientist, Applied AI Solutions collects, explores, and analyzes large, complex datasets to improve business and client outcomes. The role designs and deploys data models, algorithms, and machine learning solutions; performs custom analyses; and translates business, legal, and regulatory requirements into practical analytic approaches. The position also develops and applies algorithmic testing methods to evaluate AI systems and tools, including bias and accuracy. Working with lawyers, clients, and cross-functional teams, the Data Scientist, Applied AI Solutions delivers data-driven solutions with measurable business impact.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Develops and applies algorithmic testing methods to evaluate AI systems, models, and tools for bias, accuracy, reliability, robustness, and performance.
Creates novel testing techniques, metrics, and evaluation frameworks for emerging AI systems and risks when established methods are insufficient.
Translates legal, regulatory, and business requirements into analytic objectives, testable criteria, data specifications, and practical technical solutions.
Works with internal stakeholders, lawyers, and clients to identify opportunities to leverage organizational and client data to address business, legal, investigative, and regulatory needs.
Prioritizes, scopes, and manages multiple concurrent data science projects and client engagements, with accountability for delivery quality, timelines, measurable business outcomes, and commercially valuable solutions.
Designs, builds, deploys, and supports production machine learning models and data science solutions at scale, including solutions for privilege review and related legal workflows.
Designs representative test datasets, test cases, benchmarks, validation protocols, and monitoring approaches; documents methodologies, results, limitations, and recommendations.
Assesses the quality, completeness, representativeness, and accuracy of structured and unstructured data sources and data-gathering techniques.
Uses Python and SQL extensively to build models, data pipelines, testing tools, and analyses.
Manages structured and unstructured datasets in secure enterprise environments and works with Azure AI services or comparable enterprise cloud and data platforms.
Develops custom data models, algorithms, and predictive solutions that improve client outcomes and support data-driven decision-making.
Coordinates with legal, technical, and business teams to implement solutions, monitor outcomes, and refine models and testing methods.
Communicates methods, findings, risks, and actionable insights to technical and non-technical audiences through client-ready analyses, documentation, and presentations.
Establishes and applies best practices for reproducible analysis, model governance, quality assurance, data protection, and reporting.
Supports the delivery of revenue-generating client solutions within consulting or professional-services delivery models.
Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills

Experience in a law firm or other legal-services environment is preferred.
Proven experience delivering revenue-generating client solutions with measurable outcomes, managing multiple concurrent client engagements, and operating within consulting or professional-services delivery models.
A specialization in machine-learning, artificial intelligence, cognitive science or data science is preferred.
Must be self-driven, curious and creative.
Experience must include creating and using advanced machine learning algorithms and statistics: regression, simulation, scenario analysis, modeling, clustering, decision trees, neural networks, data mining techniques, etc.
Experience with most or all of the following basic data science tools: Python, R, SQL, SAS, NLTK, Scikit-Learn, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, and Jupyter; Basic data science concepts: probability, statistics, hypothesis testing, machine learning, natural language processing, predictive modeling, data visualization; and Big data tools: Hadoop, Azure, etc.
Must be adept in agile methodologies and well-versed in machine learning, artificial intelligence and constructing data science pipelines.
Demonstrated presentation skills along with strong business acumen.
Ability to communicate actionable insights using data, often for a non-technical audience.
Significant hands-on coding experience in Python and SQL is required, including building, deploying, and supporting production machine learning models at scale.
Experience managing structured and unstructured datasets in enterprise environments and working with Azure AI services or comparable enterprise cloud and data platforms is required.
Must be able to design and execute algorithmic testing of AI systems, including bias and accuracy assessments, and create novel evaluation methods when established approaches are insufficient.
Must be able to translate legal and regulatory requirements into analytic methods, testable criteria, and defensible technical documentation.
Preferred experience includes delivering data science solutions within legal, eDiscovery, investigations, privilege review, or regulatory compliance environments.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, statistics, applied mathematics or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience

5 years of relevant experience applying data science and machine learning techniques to complex business problems, including building and deploying production models at scale.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
Comply with firm policies and procedures.
Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The selected candidate will have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

Compensation & Benefits

The firm's expected hiring range for this position is $129,808 - $206,399 depending on the candidate's geographic location, experience, skills, educational background, and overall qualifications.

DLA Piper offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, and additional benefits.

Application Process

Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted.

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. For accommodation requests, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

No immigration sponsorship is available for this position.

Job duties, requirements, and expectations may be modified at the firm's discretion at any time. This job description does not alter the at-will nature of employment.

We are committed to excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people.

DLA Piper is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Job applicant poster viewing center .

jobs.title: Jr AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Entry-Level AI/ML Engineer

Employment Type: Full-Time

Relocation: Candidate must be open to relocate

Job Summary

We are seeking a motivated Entry-Level AI/ML Engineer to join our technology team. In this role, you will assist in developing and evaluating machine learning models, preparing datasets, implementing AI solutions, and supporting the integration of intelligent systems into applications. You will work closely with senior AI/ML engineers and data professionals to solve business problems using modern artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in collecting, cleaning, and preprocessing data for AI/ML projects.
Develop, train, test, and evaluate basic machine learning models.
Apply supervised and unsupervised learning techniques to real-world problems.
Assist with feature engineering and model optimization.
Analyze model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
Support the development of AI-powered applications and solutions.
Work with Python and popular machine learning libraries and frameworks.
Assist with Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, or generative AI projects.
Explore and work with Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI APIs.
Create technical documentation and maintain project records.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and other technical teams.
Stay current with emerging AI and machine learning technologies and best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Basic understanding of machine learning and artificial intelligence concepts.
Programming experience with Python.
Familiarity with libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Basic understanding of statistics, probability, and data analysis.
Familiarity with SQL and databases.
Understanding of model training, testing, and evaluation.
Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to learn new technologies and work effectively in a team environment.

Entry level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries
